Application Data.NAME: Trophy World Awards
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Trophy World Awards specializes in the design and sale of customized trophies, awards, and promotional products. Our shop offers a variety of items for celebrations, sports events, corporate recognition, and educational achievements. Located in a high-traffic area, we provide personalized service to ensure customer satisfaction. We implement strict inventory control measures and have a security system in place to protect our assets. With over five years of continuous operation and a commitment to excellence, we cater to both local clients and online orders, maintaining a robust presence in the gift and awards market.

Underwriting Guidelines:
3.70
Gift & Souvenir Shops
Underwriting Appetite
• Preferred:
– Established retail locations with more than 3 years of continuous operation and a clean
claims history, demonstrating operational stability and effective risk management.
– Shops located in well-trafficked tourist destinations or cultural hubs, where a strong
customer service culture and consistent foot traffic reduce volatility in sales and claims.
– Businesses with well-documented inventory controls, security systems (e.g., CCTV, alarm
systems), and employee training programs focused on loss prevention.
• Acceptable:
– Retailers specializing in hobby, craft, or gift items with moderate sales volume and some
online presence.
– Mixed operations combining brick-and-mortar storefronts with e-commerce platforms,
provided there is adequate cyber risk management and inventory tracking.
– Newer businesses (1–3 years) with documented risk controls, including theft prevention
and slip-and-fall mitigation measures.
